**Skip the generative round when no minting work is scheduled.**

After a no-progress Datalog round, `chase_world_into` scans all prepared rules against the full store again, even when none can mint. The joint driver also repeats `gather` for every world. If no world has a minting producer or witness-frontier property, the first gather has already run the non-generative work. The existing empty-round path can still handle blocked or exhausted status and complete the stratum. Gate both transitions on actual minting work.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
diff --git a/crates/logic/src/physical/chase.rs b/crates/logic/src/physical/chase.rs
@@
         if !progressed {
-            if !generative {
+            if !generative && prepared.iter().any(|rule| rule.mints()) {
                 // Datalog has reached its fixpoint: let the minting rules fire.
                 generative = true;
                 continue;
diff --git a/crates/logic/src/physical/seminaive/joint.rs b/crates/logic/src/physical/seminaive/joint.rs
@@
                 if !any && !generative && !truncated && !draining_retained {
-                    // Datalog has reached its fixpoint: let the witness producers fire.
-                    generative = true;
-                    continue;
+                    let has_minting_work = runtimes.keys().any(|world| {
+                        let stratum = &plans[world].strata[index];
+                        stratum.producers.iter().any(|producer| producer.mints())
+                            || stratum
+                                .properties
+                                .iter()
+                                .any(|property| property.witness_frontier.is_some())
+                    });
+                    if has_minting_work {
+                        // Datalog has reached its fixpoint: let the witness producers fire.
+                        generative = true;
+                        continue;
+                    }
                 }
```
